approved.en: In the past week 264 armed incidents were reported, mainly in Kyiv, Moscow and Odesa, and 64 of them were carried by two or more outlets. The UCDP recorded 75 767 battle‑related deaths in 2024. Recent attacks include Russian glide‑bomb and drone strikes that killed at least 20 people in Zaporizhzhia, injured dozens in Kyiv’s Obolon and Holosiivskyi districts, and hit a medical facility in Kharkiv. Trump has called for a new Ukrainian president, linking the diesel deal and the war’s continuation.

Nylige angrep inkluderer russiske glide‑bombe- og dronstrike som drepte minst 20 personer i Zaporizhzhia, såret dusinvis i Kyivs Obolon- og Holosiivskyi-distrikt, og traff en medisinsk fasilitet i Kharkiv. Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh airport has been hit repeatedly, with at least 12 killed and over 300 injured in the latest missile attack, prompting a suspension of operations. Iran’s forces are reported to be tightening control of the Strait of Hormuz, with nearly 20 vessels struck, and its military is accused of arson at RAF Fairford. The conflict has also seen U.S. troop casualties rise to 21.

Riyadh‑flyplassen i Saudi-Arabia har blitt rammet gjentatte ganger, med minst 12 drept og over 300 sårede i det siste missilangrepet, noe som førte til at driften ble stanset. Iran strammer grepet om Hormuz, med nesten 20 skip som ble truffet, og deres militær blir beskyldt for brannstiftelse på RAF Fairford. Konflikten har også ført til at amerikanske soldater døde, nå 21.

approved.en: 25 armed incidents were reported in the past seven days, mainly in Baghdad, Maysan and Kirkuk, and none were carried by more than one outlet. The UCDP recorded 396 battle‑related deaths in 2024. Tensions are rising in Iraqi Kurdistan as Iran continues strikes against Kurdish forces, while the US and Iraq discuss post‑coalition ties and the dinar exchange rate. ISIS is exploiting security gaps after the coalition withdrawal, with renewed attacks in Hawija, and Iranian drones have struck a Kurdish organization’s base near Erbil. The Iraqi prime minister is set to embark on a Gulf tour, and Kurdish leaders are weighing the impacts of the US withdrawal.
approved.nb: 25 væpnede hendelser ble rapportert de siste syv dagene, hovedsakelig i Bagdad, Maysan og Kirkuk, og ingen ble dekket av mer enn ett medie. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024. Spenningene øker i irakisk Kurdistan ettersom Iran fortsetter angrep mot kurdiske styrker, mens USA og Irak diskuterer post‑koalisjonsforbindelser og valutakursen for dinaren. ISIS utnytter sikkerhetshull etter koalisjonsavtrekkingen, med nye angrep i Hawija, og iranske droner har truffet en kurdisk organisasjons base nær Erbil. Iraks statsminister skal på Gulf‑tur, og kurdiske ledere vurderer konsekvensene av USAs tilbaketrekning.
